sloka: तथा तयोर्विहरतोः सीताराघवयोश्चिरम् ।अत्यक्रामच्छुभः कालः शैशिरो भोगदः सदा ।। ७.४२.२४ ॥
transliteration: tathā tayorviharatoḥ sītārāghavayościram ।atyakrāmacchubhaḥ kālaḥ śaiśiro bhogadaḥ sadā ।। 7.42.24 ॥

translations.english: Rama, filled with joy, thus shone with splendor like Vasishtha seated with Arundhati, with Sita resembling a celestial nymph.
